## [Waited 3 months on a doormat only for the wrong one to show up.](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/65725ee66be448b8ec930217)
I ordered a door mat on September 21. It is December 7 and I just got it. Never stated back order or anything. The bloom doormat to be exact. After waiting 2 months I reached out asking for a refund as I was tired of waiting. Then, all of a sudden it was ready to ship they said. Well, I received it today it was completely different not even close to what I ordered. Seems as if they dodged a refund and sent what was in stock hoping I’d be ok with it. Sadly, I’ll be taking it up with my cc company if I’m refunded.

December 7, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Dec 13, 2023

We truly apologize for the mix-up with your order and the frustration it has caused. I'm glad to inform you that our team has reviewed your situation and has processed a full refund for the doormat. We hope this resolution is satisfactory and appreciate your patience in this matter.
